meta.purpose: Closure-proof corpus for the messaging attention hypergraph. A SIZED, HAND-LABELED cross-platform corpus (2 platforms: the synthetic 5th adapter `fakeplatform` as RAW rows + an already-projected `source_legacy` envelope ledger). Each thread carries an explicit `label` = needs_response | no_response, with a `reason`. The eval measures precision (no ambient group chatter or closer surfaces) + recall (every real ask surfaces) + operator unification (operator's own rows never surface, operator collapses to person:operator) + cross-platform dedup collapse (one human on both platforms -> ONE row).

labels.needs_response: they spoke last, directed at me, substantive -> MUST surface (recall)
labels.no_response: either I spoke last, OR a pure closer, OR undirected ambient group chatter, OR my own outbound -> MUST NOT surface (precision)

people.rhea: cross-platform human: fakeplatform (+15557770001) AND source_legacy (+15557770001@legacy.example) -> ONE person via E.164 shape. Waiting on you on BOTH; latest source_legacy ask is more recent. Dedup MUST collapse 2 -> 1.
people.milo: fakeplatform DM only (+15557770002); a direct substantive ask -> needs_response.
people.the-crew (group): fakeplatform group thread `grp_crew`: ambient chatter NOT directed at me (no mention, no reply, no addressing) -> no_response (PRECISION: must NOT surface).
people.nadia (group mention): fakeplatform group thread `grp_launch`: she @-mentions the operator with a real ask -> needs_response (RECALL through a group via mention_me).
people.owen: fakeplatform DM `dm_owen`: a pure closer ('ah cool, thanks!') -> no_response (N8 substance down-rank).
people.priya: source_legacy DM: she asked, but I (user) REPLIED last -> answered -> no_response.
people.operator: user / alex@example.com; the operator's OWN outbound rows appear on both platforms and must NEVER surface, and must unify to person:operator.
